state_machine.phase_meaning: phase is the pre-scan PLC state: 0=Idle, 1=Cleaning, 2=Filling, 3=Capping, 4=Packing, 5=Complete. At the end of each scan, phase is updated to nextPhase.

states.name: IDLE
states.description: Idle, waiting for a bottle to be detected.

states.name: CLEANING
states.description: Cleaning pump runs until operator confirms cleaning completion.

states.name: FILLING
states.description: Filling valve runs until operator confirms filling completion.

states.name: CAPPING
states.description: Capping machine runs until operator confirms capping completion.

states.name: PACKING
states.description: Packing machine runs until operator confirms packaging completion.

states.name: COMPLETE
states.description: Packaging completion light is on until operator confirms bottle pickup.

state_machine.output_rule: Outputs are derived from nextPhase in the same scan: Pump_Motor := (nextPhase = 1); Filling_Valve := (nextPhase = 2); Capping_Machine := (nextPhase = 3); Packing_Machine := (nextPhase = 4); Completion_Light := (nextPhase = 5); all other outputs FALSE. At scan end, phase := nextPhase. This guarantees one-hot process outputs.
transition_policy: Inputs are sampled once per scan and evaluated against the pre-scan phase.
At most one phase transition is allowed per scan.
Confirmation inputs outside their matching pre-scan phase are ignored and cannot skip phases.
Confirmation inputs are level-sampled; a held confirmation may complete its phase on a later scan once that phase is active.
If finishedButton returns phase 5 to phase 0, a still-present bottle may start a new cleaning cycle only on the following idle scan.
All outputs are assigned every scan from nextPhase rather than using set/reset latches, ensuring deterministic one-hot output behavior.

timer_plan.rationale: No timed process step, delay, or debounce duration is specified in the requirements. Phase progression is controlled only by level-sampled sensors and operator confirmation buttons. If hardware debounce is required, it should be implemented outside this phase-control FB using an external timer with a PT value taken from the electrical/hardware specification.

safety_priorities: Maintain mutual exclusion: at most one of Pump_Motor, Filling_Valve, Capping_Machine, Packing_Machine, and Completion_Light may be TRUE.
Use the pre-scan phase to gate confirmations: only the confirmation matching the active pre-scan phase may influence nextPhase.
Allow at most one phase transition per scan; never skip phases even if multiple inputs are TRUE or held.
Drive outputs only from nextPhase so the selected actuator for the next PLC state is the only energized process output.
Completion_Light must remain ON during phase 5 until finishedButton is TRUE, and only finishedButton may return the system to idle.
On initialization or reset, force phase = 0 and all process outputs FALSE.
operational_priorities: Compute nextPhase with a single CASE or IF/ELSIF structure using the old phase and current sampled inputs.
Assign all outputs every scan from nextPhase to avoid stale latched states.
Treat confirmation buttons as level-sampled signals; a held confirmation can complete its phase later when that phase becomes active, but cannot skip phases.
Permit a new cycle when a bottle is still present only on the scan after the system has returned to idle.
Keep the FB deterministic and avoid relying on previous-scan input stability unless explicitly latched.
